family.description: Three pre-registered Cost-Aware Entry Release candidates evaluated on one decision snapshot, one legal candidate set, one Native LRU state and one Workload Trace.

candidates.name: Original Cost-Aware Entry Release
purpose: test whether the original cost model produces useful decisions in a more competitive candidate set
separate decision-space limitation from cost-model discrimination failure
inspect the original cost estimate, reuse-probability proxy and branch behavior
candidates.score: original frozen A1 score; no re-derivation or simplification
candidates.decision_branches: complete original A1 ladder including all branches; Step 2 is A1's original cost rule
candidates.victim_modeling: NONE: Entry Release selection is followed by Native LRU physical victim selection
candidates.fallback: ORIGINAL_A1_FALLBACK_BRANCH; record branch identity and reason
candidates.main_conditions: candidate competition and original cost/reuse proxies are observable

candidates.name: Suffix-Cost-Aware Entry Release
purpose: test whether Prefix/Suffix depth information improves candidate ordering
test whether A3 adds decision discrimination relative to A1
test dependence on prefix depth and candidate distribution
input_signals: A1 ladder state for non-Step-2 branches
candidates.decision_branches: A3 replaces only A1 Step 2; every other A1 branch is retained unchanged
candidates.victim_modeling: NONE: Entry Release selection is followed by Native LRU physical victim selection
candidates.fallback: A1 branch fallback per frozen A3 implementation; record branch identity
candidates.main_conditions: suffix depth is measurable and varies across legal candidates

candidates.name: Downstream-Victim-Aware Entry Release v1
candidates.implementation_source: new v1 candidate; requires CPU candidate-selection gate
purpose: link Entry Release to the downstream Native LRU Physical Victim Set
avoid ranking by Entry-local cost only
model which Blocks would actually be evicted and their downstream reuse risk
test whether direct Victim Set modeling is more valuable than A1/A3
input_signals: complete Native BlockPool and FreeKVCacheBlockQueue state
block refcounts, eligibility and protection state
pending tool gap observable at decision time
Native LRU full victim sequence simulation
candidates.score: loss(X) = sum(block_weight(b) for b in simulated_native_victim_set(X)); select min loss; tie-break to A0

score_contract.victim_set: simulated Native LRU victim set after releasing candidate X, including the full victim sequence and refcount/protection effects
score_contract.block_weight: 1 if the block belongs to an active follow-up chain whose pending tool gap is observable and 0 <= gap <= H; else 0
score_contract.active_followup_chain: a Program/Turn chain already present in the controller with a next request or pending tool result; its chain ID and block ownership are known before the decision
score_contract.pending_tool_gap: timer/next-arrival state already armed in the controller at decision time; not future turn content and not future reuse outcome
score_contract.tie_break: A0 selection; if A0 is not unique, frozen A0 tie-break

candidates.fallback: FAIL_CLOSED_ON_MISSING_EVIDENCE; A0 tie-break only on equal loss or no legal candidate
candidates.main_conditions: victim set and active chain state are fully observable
failure_conditions: victim simulation diverges from Native LRU

comparison_matrix.A1_ORIGINAL: original A1 cost, reuse proxy, A1 branch state
comparison_matrix.A3_SUFFIX: q_X, prefill_X, S_X, m_X, A1 branch state
comparison_matrix.DVA_ER_V1: A0 candidates, BlockPool/FreeQueue, refcount/eligibility/protection, active chains, pending tool gap

comparison_matrix.A1_ORIGINAL: original cost/reuse proxy and full A1 ladder
comparison_matrix.A3_SUFFIX: suffix depth replacement of A1 Step 2
suffix components plus A1 branch state
comparison_matrix.DVA_ER_V1: complete Native pool/free-queue/refcount/protection and full victim sequence

comparison_matrix.A1_ORIGINAL: original cost model has discriminating candidates
comparison_matrix.DVA_ER_V1: victim set and active follow-ups are observable and diverge

comparison_matrix.A1_ORIGINAL: original A1 fallback branch; fail closed on missing evidence
comparison_matrix.A3_SUFFIX: A1 branch fallback; fail closed on missing depth
comparison_matrix.DVA_ER_V1: A0 tie-break only on equal loss/no legal candidate; fail closed on missing state

evaluation_stages.purpose: deterministic, pre-outcome decision-space and divergence evaluation on the unified snapshot
questions: do all three algorithms have a distinguishable decision space?
does DVA-ER produce selections different from A1/A3?
does selection divergence change the Native LRU victim set?
when does missing evidence prevent a valid decision?

evaluation_stages.purpose: complete trajectory replay for each algorithm; no local sum

checks: A1 complete implementation and historical-result reproduction
A3 suffix cost and non-Step-2 A1 branch consistency
DVA-ER victim simulation and online-input legality

data_partitions.use: historical reproduction, mechanism diagnosis, exploratory analysis
correctness, ranking ability and mechanism boundaries

before_formal_unblinding: DVA-ER implementation, H, tie-break and input field set hash

dva_er_open_requirements: H definition and numeric value (60s; sensitivity 30/120)
no future Turn or future reuse outcome
